issues.description: LaTeX uses \begin{para} ... \end{para} — 'para' is not a standard LaTeX environment in common classes and may break compilation.
issues.required_fix: Replace the custom environment with a standard LaTeX construct (e.g. plain paragraph text, \paragraph{...} or \begin{quote}...\end{quote}), or define the 'para' environment in the preamble.
